packet.name: Adaptive Survival
packet.description: Draft: fix observed lethal misses and defensive overplay in the Ironclad Overgrowth baseline. Requires approval before a run.
packet.goal: Maximize survival and the chance of winning the run. Build a coherent deck from the offers; do not force an archetype.

modules.name: Vantom
modules.prompt: Strip Slippery with cheap small hits before committing large attacks: each damaging hit is capped at 1 while a stack remains. Recheck remaining stacks after each action. Prepare defense for Dismember and avoid letting its statuses and Prepare Strength accumulate. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.
modules.rationale: Encounter-specific tactics grounded in the installed game’s encounter, monster and power implementations. Re-evaluate after each action; hidden draws and RNG remain unknown.

modules.name: Ceremonial Beast
modules.prompt: First check lethal against the last enemy before Block. Plow is an HP threshold: unblocked damage that leaves the Beast at or below its current Plow amount stuns it and removes its Strength and Plow. Compare current HP minus that threshold with your available damage; partial progress does not interrupt. Beast Cry applies Ringing: after your first card play that turn, Ringing-afflicted cards cannot be played. Plan that first card for the largest useful effect; do not start with a low-value setup card expecting to play several more. Read current powers and legal actions because the fight changes after the stun.
modules.rationale: User-requested self-contained definitions of Plow and Beast Cry/Ringing. This fight was not reached in the baseline; this correction is sourced from the installed rules, not claimed playtest evidence.

modules.name: The Kin
modules.prompt: Compare killing Kin Followers to prevent their attacks against focusing the Kin Priest. Followers are minions; a reachable priest kill can end their threat. Account for the priest alternating Frail and Weak attacks before its multi-hit Beam. Establish damage before repeated Ritual Strength ramps. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.
modules.rationale: Encounter-specific tactics grounded in the installed game’s encounter, monster and power implementations. Re-evaluate after each action; hidden draws and RNG remain unknown.

modules.name: Bygone Effigy
modules.prompt: Exploit Slow: each card played increases subsequent powered attack damage this turn. Play useful low-cost setup before heavy attacks when doing so still leaves enough energy. The opening sleep and wake moves are a setup window; the effigy then gains Strength and repeatedly slashes. Damage does not control its wake timing, so use the opening to build damage rather than waiting for a supposedly safer wake-up. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Byrdonis
modules.prompt: First check lethal: if an offered attack kills the last enemy, play it before Block; a dead enemy does not attack. Byrdonis gains Strength every enemy turn, increasing damage on every hit. Repeated defense-only turns make this fight harder. Prefer damage that shortens the fight while surviving. For equal energy and Block, prefer Iron Wave over Defend here because it also damages Byrdonis. Play Setup Strike before other attacks to use its temporary Strength. Use the displayed damage preview; do not reserve energy for defense after lethal becomes available.
modules.rationale: Baseline floor 8, move 112: chose Defend with 1 energy despite lethal Strike; suffered 25 avoidable HP loss. Move 93: Defend instead of equal-cost/equal-Block Iron Wave left damage unused. Applies only to this enemy, which has no attack retaliation in the installed implementation.

modules.name: Phrog Parasite
modules.prompt: Check whether an offered attack kills an enemy before spending energy on Block. Phrog Parasite alternates adding Infection to discard and a four-hit Lash. Killing it spawns four Wrigglers; that is not victory. Wrigglers start stunned: spend that window killing them or setting up efficient damage, not gaining Block against zero incoming damage. Focus on removing a Wriggler that would otherwise attack; consider area damage. Play temporary Strength before other attacks and prefer damage-plus-Block over equal-cost equal-Block defense when there is no harmful attack trigger.
modules.rationale: Baseline died on floor 12 after taking excessive elite damage. Explicitly separates parasite phase from stunned Wriggler cleanup and tells the stateless model what to do during that window.

modules.name: Waterfall Giant
modules.prompt: Pressure grows throughout this fight. Zero HP does not immediately end combat: Steam Eruption keeps the giant present for its explosion. Kill promptly to limit pressure, then respect the displayed death-blow intent and keep enough defense for the explosion. Do not end turn assuming the kill made you safe. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Soul Fysh
modules.prompt: Use Fade/Intangible turns for setup, defense and clearing statuses rather than wasting large hits. Save burst for when Intangible expires. Beckon and Gaze add statuses; use available exhaust or draw to preserve useful hands. Scream applies Vulnerable, so account for increased damage on following turns. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Lagavulin Matriarch
modules.prompt: Exploit Asleep turns to establish powers and retained resources before waking it; check Plating and the damage needed to wake it rather than spending weak attacks casually. After waking, race repeated Soul Siphon: it lowers your Strength and Dexterity while raising hers. Plan defense around Disembowel multi-hits and spend useful potions before the stat loss compounds. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Phantasmal Gardeners
modules.prompt: Skittish grants Block after the first damaging card attack each turn. Lead with a substantial attack or multi-hit card rather than a tiny chip that activates its protection before your main hit. Compare focusing one gardener to remove an attack with efficient area damage. Their Enlarge turns increase Strength; use the opening without allowing endless scaling. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Skulking Colony
modules.prompt: Hardened Shell limits HP damage per turn. Reach the remaining damage allowance efficiently, then spend remaining resources on defense, setup or future turns instead of attacks that cannot remove more HP. Watch the displayed remaining allowance and current Block separately. Inertia adds Strength, so plan sustained defense across the unavoidable multiple turns. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Terror Eel
modules.prompt: Check Shriek: crossing its HP threshold with unblocked damage stuns the eel. Calculate whether burst can reach that threshold this turn before spending energy on Block. The stun leads toward Terror and severe Vulnerable, so use the window to finish or prepare defense; do not assume the interruption permanently removes the threat. Respect Thrash multi-hits and Vigor. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: The Insatiable
modules.prompt: Sandpit is a lethal countdown, not ordinary damage that Block can solve. Prioritize ending the fight before it expires. Read generated card effects for any way to extend the countdown; only take setup that pays back before the deadline. Balance Lunging Bite/Thrash defense against the damage race and spend damage potions early enough to matter. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Knowledge Demon
modules.prompt: Curse of Knowledge forces a choice: compare the exact offered curse effects with your deck, exhaust access and remaining fight length. The attack cycle includes a three-hit Knowledge Overwhelming and Ponder, which attacks, heals and gains Strength. Aim burst before Ponder when lethal is possible; do not sacrifice survival chasing damage that its heal will erase. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Kaiser Crab
modules.prompt: Inspect Crusher and Rocket separately. Killing one triggers Crab Rage on the survivor, granting Strength and a large Block burst: compare softening both before the first kill with removing an immediate threat. Account for Surrounded and current facing through displayed damage; sequence your final targeted attack accordingly when useful. Use Rocket charge/recharge windows to prepare for its laser; Crusher multi-hits and Weak/Frail can make that turn worse. modules.name: Decimillipede
modules.prompt: Segments reattach after being downed. Coordinate damage so all segments can be defeated before revivals, using area damage and finishing low-HP segments close together. Temporarily downing a segment can prevent an attack, but repeated isolated kills waste resources. Account for Constrict Weak and Bulk Strength when choosing the kill order. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Entomancer
modules.prompt: Personal Hive adds Dazed to draw when powered attacks hit it; repeated small hits, including multi-hits, can flood future hands. Prefer damage per hit and non-attack damage where available, and avoid chip attacks with poor payoff. Hive and Strength ramp over time, so balance that restraint with a prompt kill; do not block indefinitely while the deck clogs. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Infested Prisms
modules.prompt: Vital Spark afflicts Skills with Tainted, and playing affected Skills applies Tainted to you, adding damage to each powered hit received until the enemy turn ends. Multi-hit intents make this especially costly. Compare each defensive or draw Skill against its displayed penalty rather than automatically playing it. Pulsate increases the pressure while attacking and blocking. Favor efficient attacks or other damage sources, and only pay the Skill penalty when survival or a strong payoff justifies it. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Queen
modules.prompt: Read Chains of Binding and the changed card text before sequencing plays. Prepare for You Are Mine applying long-lasting Weak, Frail and Vulnerable; use available prevention when it materially helps. Compare removing Torch Head Amalgams against advancing damage on Queen, who buffs her allies. Once her direct attack phase starts, protect against the five-hit Off With Your Head and Execution instead of assuming the earlier support pattern continues. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Test Subject
modules.prompt: Plan for three forms: the first apparent kill is not victory. Preserve enough resources for the later forms while exploiting a reachable phase transition to avoid an attack. Read current Adaptable and Enrage before playing setup cards. Later phases add Painful Stabs and Nemesis; reassess damage and status pressure after each revival rather than reusing the first-form plan. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Aeonglass
modules.prompt: Track Withering Presence: every six card plays creates Wither in hand. Avoid low-value filler that crosses the counter without meaningful payoff; inspect the current Wither effect because it upgrades during the fight. Artifact initially blocks debuffs, so do not assume Weak or Vulnerable lands. Balance efficient high-impact plays against Eye Lasers multi-hits and its increasing Strength. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Knights
modules.prompt: Evaluate Flail, Spectral and Magi Knight separately rather than spreading damage evenly. Flail Knight War Chant ramps its Strength; Spectral Knight adds Hex and later multi-hit Soul Flame. Prioritize a reachable kill that removes the most dangerous current or next-turn threat, use area damage efficiently, and watch Magi Knight’s Prep Block before Magic Bomb: preserve enough defense for that burst or remove it before the bomb. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Mecha Knight
modules.prompt: Its initial Artifact stacks can absorb crucial debuffs. Strip them deliberately only if the later debuff payoff is worth the cards. Flamethrower puts Burns directly into hand, so plan status handling and end-turn damage. Windup grants Block and Strength before Heavy Cleave: use the setup window to prepare a kill or strong defense rather than mistaking it for a harmless turn. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Soul Nexus
modules.prompt: Distinguish Soul Burn single-hit burst from Maelstrom multi-hits when valuing mitigation. Drain Life applies both Weak and Vulnerable, so prepare for reduced damage output and increased incoming damage afterwards; the move name is not evidence that it heals. Use the current intent rather than assuming a fixed attack order, and spend potions when they prevent a dangerous debuffed turn. Use the observed intent values and current card/power text over fixed damage assumptions.

modules.name: Boss fight
modules.prompt: Plan for a long fight: establish sustainable damage and defense without taking avoidable early damage. Compare scaling setup against the current attack. Spend consumables when they materially improve survival; do not hoard through lethal.
modules.rationale: Sustained scaling matters more than preserving every consumable.

modules.name: Elite fight
modules.prompt: Treat health as a scarce resource. Identify the most dangerous visible threat and compare a fast kill against blocking. Use potions aggressively when they prevent substantial damage or a dangerous additional turn.
modules.rationale: Dangerous fights need a different resource policy than routine encounters.

modules.name: Multiple enemies
modules.prompt: Compare total incoming damage after each possible kill. Focus down a threat when doing so removes an attack; compare that with area damage. Avoid spreading damage without a payoff. Preserve enough defense against survivors.
modules.rationale: An encounter group covers many normal fights without requiring every enemy to be named.

modules.name: Normal encounter
modules.prompt: Check immediate lethal and preventable incoming damage. Prefer efficient kills and avoid unnecessary setup if the fight is nearly over. Preserve health and consumables for harder rooms, but use a potion when the saving is substantial.
modules.rationale: Generic combat fallback, including unrecognized enemies.

modules.name: Pending card choice
modules.prompt: Resolve the originating card’s purpose. Respect selection limits and already selected cards. For exhaust or discard, compare each card’s remaining value and trigger effects; do not treat removal from hand as automatically bad.
modules.rationale: Nested choices need source context, not a fresh combat plan.

modules.name: Card rewards
modules.prompt: Draft for the deck’s current weaknesses: reliable damage, defense, consistency and late-game scaling. Reward synergy without forcing it. Skip when every card reduces consistency. Compare the full effect of offered bundles.
modules.rationale: Avoid archetype lock-in and automatic deck growth.

modules.name: Upgrade / remove / transform
modules.prompt: Read the selection purpose first. Upgrade a frequently useful card with a material payoff; remove a liability; transform an expendable card. Consider draw consistency and the deck’s current curve. Do not confuse removal with upgrade.
modules.rationale: Purpose-sensitive permanent deck decisions.

modules.name: Collect rewards
modules.prompt: Collect free gold and useful rewards before leaving. Take a potion when offered and useful; compare swaps against existing potions. Evaluate relic drawbacks against this deck rather than assuming every relic is beneficial.
modules.rationale: Explicitly prevents accidental gold/potion skips without hardcoding model choices.

modules.name: Map route
modules.prompt: Use current health, deck readiness and reachable future rooms. Seek upgrades and elite rewards when survivable, preserve access to healing when needed, and visit shops when gold supports meaningful purchases. Avoid choosing solely by the next room.
modules.rationale: Plans routes from the reachable graph.

modules.name: Shop
modules.prompt: Compare removal, cards, relics and potions by marginal benefit to this deck. Keep the actual gold budget in mind. Purchase immediate survival if necessary; otherwise prioritize consistency and scaling. Leaving without buying is valid.
modules.rationale: Gold is a budget, not an obligation to purchase.

modules.name: Rest site
modules.prompt: Compare healing against upgrade value and current survival margin. Do not rest automatically at a fixed health percentage; account for available options and relic effects.
modules.rationale: Uses health and deck context rather than a rigid threshold.

modules.name: Event fallback
modules.prompt: Read the actual event text and explicit costs. Value health, gold, deck changes and permanent rewards together. Avoid paying for weak additions. Treat unknown outcomes as uncertain rather than inventing rewards or probabilities.
modules.rationale: Safe fallback until an event has an exact authored module.

modules.name: Other decision
modules.prompt: Choose the legal action that best improves survival and the chance of winning. Use the supplied rules and do not invent hidden information.
modules.rationale: Fail-safe strategy selection; prompt projection still rejects unsupported game decision kinds.
